use_case: OpenAI to Accelerate Secure AI Deployment for Enterprises Across Core Operations
reported_delivery_components: ARMONK, N.Y. , August 13, 2026 — IBM (NYSE: IBM ) today announced a strategic partnership with OpenAI to help enterprises deliver business outcomes by deploying AI at scale across core business operations and complex workflows, while strengthening cyber defense and resilience through programs like OpenAI Daybreak. The partnership includes joint-go-to market initiatives and creating industry-specific solutions for financial services, government, telecommunications, and retail, as well as key enterprise domains such as finance, procurement, customer operations, and HR.

The companies plan to help clients modernize legacy applications and accelerate software development by bringing together OpenAI Codex and ChatGPT Work with IBM’s industry, technology and domain expertise, including integration with IBM Consulting Advantage. The collaboration is designed to help organizations simplify engineering processes and speed the delivery of new digital products and services.

use_case: AI company | Business News This Week
reported_delivery_components: Gurugram, Aug 10: Cars24 announced the launch of Deployment Inc, an independent enterprise AI company that will help organisations design, implement and operate AI systems across critical business workflows.

Deployment Inc will give customers one accountable team. Its forward-deployed engineers, or FDEs, will work from inside the customer’s organisation. They will begin with a specific workflow and an agreed business metric, connect the necessary models to the company’s data and systems, deploy the new workflow against real traffic and remain involved until it operates reliably at scale.

Deployment Inc plans to hire 50 engineers this month, primarily forward-deployed engineers, alongside AI strategy and go-to-market professionals. The company is also opening its first set of engagements to enterprises seeking to redesign critical operations around AI.

Cars24 is investing an initial $5 million in Deployment Inc and will become its first customer. Deployment Inc will operate as an independent company serving enterprises across industries, including financial services, consumer businesses, healthcare, manufacturing, logistics and technology.
